summary.text: Bryan Goldberg is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Elaine Davis (R).
He is a businessman who also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Goldberg was born in Miami, Florida, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a businessman.
Goldberg advanced from the Democratic primary for District 18 unopposed in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Elaine Davis, 46.2 percent to 53.8 percent.
He advanced unopposed from the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for the same seat.
